summary: Live Expo preview loaded at mobile size and backend profile/memory/mood CRUD with base64 persistence passed.

minor.issue: No single-memory GET route exists; post-delete verification can only use list, while the requested CRUD contract expects GET verification.

integration_issues.issue: src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL / expo extra backendUrl, not the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable; currently works only because the preview env exposes the public variant.

react_native_issues.issue: Interactive controls do not expose data-testid/testID attributes, making robust automated mobile coverage difficult.

action_items: Use EXPO_BACKEND_URL consistently (or explicitly document the public variant) in frontend API configuration.
Add testID attributes to tabs, inputs, mood pills, and primary buttons.
Consider adding GET /api/memories/{memory_id} for complete CRUD verification.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend load logs show only the expected web Animated useNativeDriver fallback and no red-screen crash.
Error states are mostly console.warn-only on Today, Journal, Mood, and Me; users receive no retry UI when API loading fails.

success_rate.frontend: 100% load smoke; tab assertions incomplete due malformed test script

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one TEST_-prefixed profile/memory during the regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview screenshot showed onboarding overlay, Today empty state, and five bottom tabs at 375x667. A second UI script attempt had a Python string syntax error and should be rerun with corrected quoting.
rca_of_issue: The backend intentionally implements collection GET /api/memories?user_id=... but not item GET, so a standard delete-to-404 item verification cannot be performed. Frontend testability is reduced because screen controls omit testID props.
